notes.title: 📣 Announcement of the second episode of Uncanny Tales — 1992
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, friends!

Today, I’m happy to share that the second episode of the series is in development and has its own Steam page! It’s called Uncanny Tales: 1992, and it will tell a new, dark story inspired by Soviet horror tales.

What you can expect: 
🕯 More immersion and interactivity 
📜 Less long texts — more involvement in the process 
🏚 A haunting atmosphere of the '90s 
📅 A longer playthrough

🛒 Add Uncanny Tales: 1992 to your wishlist — it really helps with promotion 🙏
